recentItems.title: Is Baggy Trousers a Better Song than Another Brick in the Wall (Part 2)?
recentItems.description: Baggy Trousers was Madness’ front man Sugg’s response to Pink Floyd’s Another Brick In The Wall (Part 2). We take a look at both songs and ask why one is often considered to be superior to the other, both artistically and musically, and the contexts and reasons for those assumptions.

recentItems.title: SID JAMES - COR BLIMEY! WHAT A CARRY ON!
recentItems.description:
A mini-documentary on the classic Carry On star Sid James

This mini-documentary explores the Carry On film actor Sid James. Charting his life and his influence on British culture. The video examines the actor's rapid rise to fame and his relationships with fellow actors in the iconic Carry On film franchise. From innuendo-laden dialogue to working-class representation, it’s a nostalgic look at a comedy acting legend.
